fact_description: 随机网络 line is consistently above 中介网络 line throughout the chart

true_probe.statement: 在整个图表中，随机网络的值始终高于中介网络，是否正确？
true_probe.explanation: Random network values are not always higher than mediator networks.

false_probe.statement: 在整个图表中，中介网络的值始终高于随机网络，是否正确？
false_probe.explanation: Not always; random network exceeds mediator network sometimes.
